diagnostics.message: null_resource.delete_http_settings must depend on null_resource.delete_probe so Terraform destroys HTTP settings before deleting the probes they reference. Its dependency on null_resource.set_probe does not order the destroy-time provisioner on null_resource.delete_probe.

null_resource.delete_http_listener must depend on null_resource.delete_frontend_port so reverse destroy ordering removes listeners before their referenced frontend ports. The existing dependency on null_resource.set_frontend_port does not order the destroy-time provisioner on null_resource.delete_frontend_port.
null_resource.set_http_settings already depends on null_resource.set_backend_pools through null_resource.set_probe (and through null_resource.set_root_cert); the direct depends_on is redundant.
